blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets for your Mac workflow

You do not need a native app to get the most out of Google Sheets on your Mac. Open Chrome and navigate to sheets.google.com. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Select Cast, Save, and Share. Then click Install page as app. This creates a shortcut in your Applications folder. You can now open Sheets in its own window. This keeps your procurement data separate from your browser tabs.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for procurement data

Speed matters when you are reconciling invoices or comparing vendor quotes. Press ⌘ + / to open the full list of shortcuts inside Sheets. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace text across your spend reports. If you need to hide rows with completed purchase orders, select them and press ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. To hide columns, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0.

You can handle up to 20 million cells in a single sheet. If your spreadsheet starts to lag, check your formulas. Avoid using too many volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET. These recalculate every time you change a cell. Use static values where possible. If you need to count unique vendors in a list, use the UNIQUE function combined with COUNTA.

blocks.text: Reconciliation often involves comparing two lists. Use VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP to match invoice numbers against your purchase orders. If you get an #N/A error, it means the value is missing. Wrap your formula in IFERROR to keep your view clean. For example, IFERROR(VLOOKUP(...), "Not Found"). This helps you spot discrepancies immediately.

Lazur helps you stay in the flow while working on your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about any menu item or setting you cannot find. If you are stuck on a complex formula, ask Lazur to explain how it works. You can also use Lazur to dictate notes about a vendor call directly into a cell. It saves you from switching windows or typing manually.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No. Google Sheets is a web application. You can create a Progressive Web App shortcut in Chrome to make it behave like a desktop app.

faq.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / while inside any Google Sheet to open the shortcut helper.

faq.question: What is the cell limit for Google Sheets?
faq.answer: As of September 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.
